battle.name: 塞保戰爭
battle.brief: 一八八四年八月到一八八五年四月，中法戰爭在越南北部與中越邊境全面展開。馮子材守鎮南關，劉永福率黑旗軍據諒山，北黎與紙橋兩役中法軍都用上人力轉動的加特林機槍，六管齊射的射速把叢林與村落間的近距離交火改成機槍對機槍的角力；三月順化陷落後法軍全線收兵。

kit.name: 加特林機槍
kit.history: 六根管子用人力轉動。它的後坐力分散在六次上，所以能壓住一個師。

countries: 交戰的一方是清帝國與其背後的藩屬體系。兩廣總督岑春煊在一八八四年主持廣西防務，因擅自與法方議和被撤職；張樹聲接任後不久病逝，張之洞於一八八四年年底出任兩廣總督，統轄廣東、廣西兩省軍務。西線以廣西軍為主，民政由廣西布政使唐景崧襄助，軍事上分為數支：馮子材所部關外軍守鎮南關與文淵，劉永福的黑旗軍與各路鄉勇、團練據守諒山、興化與廣西邊境，綠營與新募練勇擔任後方與城防；雲南方面由雲南巡撫劉錦棠與提督鮑超、郭松齡籌劃，滇軍於一八八五年春入越策應。另一方是法國：安南（越南）阮朝朝廷在法軍攻佔河內之後淪為傀儡，法國以安南－東京總督兼民政總長保羅·貝爾主持北越的接管，軍事上由遠征軍與法屬印度支那兵團作戰，指揮權集中於巴黎，茹費理內閣與海陸軍參謀總部決定戰與不戰。遠征軍基層由外籍兵團（第二、第三外籍團）、安南籍與東京籍的印度支那步槍兵、法國本土營及雇傭部隊組成，並由紅河與北部灣的艦隊分隊提供艦砲、運輸與封鎖。要留意的是戰爭有兩個階段：一八八三年五月至一八八四年八月屬未宣戰的「東京戰爭」，清廷既不承認法國兼併越南，也未公開放棄藩屬；正式交戰自一八八四年八月開始、翌年三月順化陷落後轉入收兵與議和。
countriesEn: The belligerent on one side was the Qing Empire together with the vassal order behind it. The Governor-General of Liangguang, Cen Chunxuan, took charge of the Guangxi defences in 1884 and was removed from office because he opened negotiations with the French without authorisation; Zhang Shusheng succeeded him but died within a few months, and Zhang Zhidong became Governor-General of Liangguang at the end of 1884, holding military authority over both Guangdong and Guangxi. On the western front the force was the Guangxi Army, assisted in civil administration by the Guangxi provincial treasurer Tang Jingsong, and militarily it fell into several parts: the Army of the Outer Pass under Feng Zicai held Zhennan Pass and Wenyuan; the Black Flag Army of Liu Yongfu, together with the local militia bands and drill units, held Lang Son, Huong Hoa and the Guangxi border; and the old Green Standard troops and newly raised companies formed the line of the rear areas and the fortified towns. In Yunnan the provincial governor Liu Jintang and the commanders Bao Chao and Guo Songling planned the campaign, and in the spring of 1885 the Yunnan army entered Tonkin to relieve the Guangxi front. The other side was France. Once the French had taken Hanoi, the Nguyễn court at Huế was reduced to a puppet, and France presided over the take-over of the north through Paul Bert, appointed Governor-General and Commissioner-General for Annam and Tonkin; the war itself was fought by the expeditionary corps and the French Indochinese troops, while authority was centralised in Paris, where the Ferry cabinet and the general staffs of the army and navy decided whether to fight at all. At the bottom of the order of battle lay the Foreign Legions, the second and third regiments of which served in Tonkin, the Indochinese tirailleurs recruited in Annam and Tonkin, French metropolitan units and hired companies, with squadrons on the Red River and in the Gulf of Tonkin providing naval gunfire, transport and blockade. It is worth noting that the war had two phases. From May 1883 to August 1884 it was an undeclared Tonkin war, in which the Qing court neither recognised the French annexation of Vietnam nor publicly renounced the vassal relationship; formal hostilities began in August 1884, and after the fall of Huế in the following March the campaign turned into a withdrawal and a negotiation.
people: 茹費理是這場戰爭的策源地。他在一八八三年內閣任內推動法國兼併安南的計劃，批准法軍攻佔河內與北寧，並在國會需要一場對外勝仗來穩固政權時，頂住反對意見，於一八八四年八月批准對清開戰。法國駐清公使寶建是執行者：他向李鴻章提出最後通牒，宣佈法國不再等待中國答覆，隨即在福建沿海動手。八月裡法軍艦隊在馬尾攻擊福建水師並砲擊福州船政局，把清廷的海上力量一次打殘，隨即沿江北上，正式與清軍交火。軍隊方面，法軍先鋒北黎縱隊由貝特·德·維耶指揮，這位曾於一八八三年五月紙橋之役以加特林與轉管砲擊退黑旗軍的指揮官，在一八八四年三月二十三日的中越伏擊中陣亡；米利埃爾在北寧城樓攻堅中身死；其後北越戰區的指揮先後由涅格萊、戈朋與巴威等將領接手，涅格萊主導一八八四年下半年的反攻與一八八五年三月的再攻，戈朋主持順化突擊，巴威接手北越戰區並把戰線推向中國境內。清廷方面最關鍵的是馮子材：他在兩廣軍政最動盪時接手關外軍，拒絕一味死守，於一八八五年三月二十三日主動反攻，在白泮洲一帶擊退法軍，另有斬獲法軍軍官與軍馬的記載，這是晚清對外戰爭中少數為清軍記下的正面勝利。劉永福的黑旗軍在紙橋、諒山與興化一線屢次挫敗法軍，成為法軍最難纏的對手；張之洞到任後力主以實力應戰，拒絕再議和約；鮑超率滇軍入越策應；岑春煊則因擅自與法方私訂和約而遭罷免，李鴻章被朝野指為在外交上讓步太多。
peopleEn: Jules Ferry was the source of the war. In his cabinet of 1883 he pushed the French plan for the annexation of Annam, approved the French seizure of Hanoi and Bac Ninh, and, in a parliament that needed a foreign victory to keep his government standing, overrode the objections and authorised war against China in August 1884. The French minister to China, Paul Beau, was the man who executed it: he delivered the last ultimatum to Li Hongzhang, declared that France would wait no longer for an answer, and within days opened fire on the Fujian coast. In August the French squadron attacked the Fujian fleet at Mawei and shelled the Fuzhou shipyard, destroying the Qing naval force in a single stroke, and then moved up the coast to open war with the Chinese armies. On the military side, the advance column at Bac Le was commanded by Berthe de Villers, the officer who had beaten back the Black Flags with Gatling guns and revolving cannon at the Paper Bridge in May 1883; he was killed in the Vietnamese-Chinese ambush of 23 March 1884, and General Millière died in the assault on the citadel of Bac Ninh. Command of the Tonkin theatre then passed in turn through Negrier, Bonnegat and Brière: Negrier directed the French counter-offensive of the second half of 1884 and the renewed offensive of March 1885, Bonnegat commanded the assault on Huế, and Brière took over the northern theatre and pushed the front towards Chinese territory. The most important figure on the Qing side was Feng Zicai. Taking over the Army of the Outer Pass in the midst of the political turbulence in the two Guang provinces, he refused a purely defensive posture and counter-attacked on 23 March 1885, throwing back the French near the White Rampart, with a record of French officers and horses taken. It was one of the few outright Qing successes in the foreign wars of the late Qing period. Liu Yongfu's Black Flag Army repeatedly beat French troops at the Paper Bridge, at Lang Son and at Huong Hoa, and was the most troublesome opponent the French faced; after Zhang Zhidong took over at Liangguang he pressed for meeting the French with force rather than negotiating again; Bao Chao led the Yunnan army into Tonkin to support the western front; and Cen Chunxuan was dismissed for opening a private armistice with the French, while Li Hongzhang was attacked at home for conceding too much in the negotiations.
kits: 加特林機槍在這場戰爭裡的位置，是法軍營級與團級火力鏈上一個速度極快、但吃彈藥、吃人力、吃道路的特殊節點。它由一八六○年的六管原型起家：六根槍管圍成一圈，人力搖動手柄，轉到槍膛朝上時擊發，後坐力分散在六次擊發裡，所以不需要像連發砲那樣的炮架與駐退機制；後來廠商改進過管數、口徑與供彈方式，法軍在北越裝備的即是這類改進型，通常架在輕型三腳架或兩輪小車上，後方跟著裝填手與彈藥箱車，運轉時需要幾個人一起操作，射速可達每分鐘數十發至一百餘發。它在實戰中最著名的位置有四處：一八八三年五月十九日紙橋之役、一八八四年三月一日北寧城樓攻堅、一八八四年三月二十三日北黎之役、一八八五年三月十八日順化皇城突擊。與它同系的火力還包括格魯格十二連裝轉管砲、以人力牽引的八十毫米迫擊砲、海軍艦上卸下的大口徑艦砲，以及十二磅、二十四磅野砲與山砲；紅河三角洲與越南北部的水路運輸，靠的是內河炮艇與沿海運輸船。清軍與黑旗軍這邊是另一套裝備：綠營的抬槍與馬槍、大量冷兵器（刀、矛、少量弓箭），以及各鄉的土炮與鳥槍；滇軍出關時攜帶的是舊式抬槍與少量後膛步槍，火力遠不如法軍，卻在山道與村落的地形上佔了便宜。運輸與補給同樣分兩層：法軍靠船運與僱用民夫維持，越北丘陵與稻田間的窄路對車載重砲極不友善；清軍靠廣西與雲南的徵發和民間挑夫，速度慢，但距離短、消耗小。
kitsEn: The Gatling gun's place in this war was that of a special link in the French chain of battalion and regimental firepower: extremely fast, but greedy for ammunition, for manpower and for roads. It grew out of the six-barrel model of 1860. Six barrels were set in a circle, a hand crank turned them, the weapon fired as each chamber came up, and the recoil was divided among six separate discharges, so that the gun needed neither the recoil mechanism nor the heavy carriage of a repeating cannon. The manufacturer later improved the number of barrels, the calibre and the feed, and the weapons the French carried into Tonkin were of these improved patterns. They were usually set on a light tripod or on a two-wheeled carriage, with loaders and an ammunition cart following behind, and several men were needed to work the crank; the rate of fire ran from several dozen rounds a minute to upwards of a hundred. It occupies four especially well-known positions on the field: the Battle of the Paper Bridge on 19 May 1883, the assault on the citadel of Bac Ninh on 1 March 1884, the action at Bac Le on 23 March 1884, and the storm of the imperial citadel at Huế on 18 March 1885. Alongside it in the French order of battle were the twelve-shot Hotchkiss revolving cannon, the eighty-millimetre mortar on a wheeled carriage, the large naval guns unhooked from their ships, and twelve- and twenty-four-pounder field and mountain guns; the movement of men and stores over the Red River delta and the north of Tonkin was carried by river gunboats and coastal transports. The Chinese and Black Flag forces had a different set of weapons: the matchlock and percussion muskets of the Green Standard, the heavy two-man carriage gun and the lighter horse musket, a large amount of cold steel in the form of sabres, spears and a few bows, together with village cannon and matchlock guns; the Yunnan army carried old two-man muskets and a few breech-loading rifles into Tonkin, with firepower far below the French, but it held the advantage of the terrain of mountain tracks and stockaded villages. Supply too ran on two levels: the French maintained themselves by ship and by hired porters, and the narrow tracks between the hills and the rice fields of northern Tonkin were deeply hostile to heavy guns on wheels; the Chinese drew on requisitions in Guangxi and Yunnan and on village porters, slower but short-hauled and cheap.
tactics: 法軍在北越的戰術核心是「先砲後步兵、再以速射武器封住路口」的路線。一八八四年三月一日北寧城樓之役最能說明：先用海軍帶來的大口徑砲轟擊城牆與角樓，同時以加特林與轉管砲封住城頭射界，步兵在砲火停歇的瞬間由缺口突入，逐段清剿城內守軍。清軍這邊的做法是結寨而守、倚村為堡，用土牆與屋舍遮蔽，抵抗攻城砲的直射火力，傷亡因此集中於城頭與缺口。一八八四年三月二十三日的北黎之役是加特林最典型的用法：法軍縱隊沿村間道路與稻田邊的小徑進逼中越邊界，遭到黑旗軍與廣西鄉勇從兩側包抄，縱隊被切斷在狹窄的林間通道裡，法軍把加特林架在路旁，與轉管砲打出交叉火力，掩護縱隊一營一營退出，隊形始終沒有潰散，傷亡雖重而未遭全滅。一八八三年五月十九日紙橋之役，方向相反而原理相同：法軍把加特林放在橋頭與兩側土堤，密集衝鋒的攻方在火網前散不成隊，傷亡集中在數百公尺內，攻勢當即瓦解。一八八五年三月的順化突擊則是教科書式的都市攻堅：法軍先以艦隊封住海門、砲擊皇城與城門，再在拂曉以工兵爆破打開缺口，突擊梯隊隨著加特林與轉管砲進入城內巷戰；守軍退入皇城後發現內門緊閉、通道狹窄，縱火與白刃同時出現在石牆之間。同一個月的鎮南關之戰是清軍唯一一次像樣的反攻：馮子材把大刀隊與密集步兵排在關前，等法軍攻勢在正面受挫、隊形散亂時反衝白泮洲，奪回文淵與鎮南關。此後清軍在滇軍入越與法軍增援到達之後轉入守勢，逐點以既設陣地消耗法軍，雙方都沒有能力再打一次大規模會戰。
tacticsEn: The tactical core of the French campaign in Tonkin was the sequence of artillery first, infantry second, and then the use of rapid-fire weapons to seal the roads. The assault on the citadel of Bac Ninh on 1 March 1884 shows it most clearly. The large naval guns were brought up against the walls and the corner towers, while Gatling guns and revolving cannon covered the firing positions on the ramparts; the infantry rushed in through the breach in the intervals between rounds and cleared the defenders in sections. The Chinese answered differently, entrenching in stockades and sheltering in villages behind earthen walls and houses against the direct fire of the siege guns, which concentrated their losses on the ramparts and at the breaches. The action at Bac Le on 23 March 1884 is the classic use of the Gatling gun. The French column was pushing along the paths between villages and the edges of the rice fields towards the Sino-Vietnamese frontier when the Black Flags and the Guangxi militia closed in from both flanks and cut the column in a narrow wooded track; the French set their Gatling guns beside the road and, with the revolving cannon, put down crossing fire that covered the withdrawal of the column battalion by battalion. The formation never broke, and although the losses were heavy it was not annihilated. At the Paper Bridge on 19 May 1883 the direction was reversed but the principle identical: the French placed Gatling guns at the head of the bridge and on the earth banks to either side, and the massed attackers could not form up in front of that sheet of fire. The losses fell within a few hundred paces, and the assault collapsed on the spot. The assault on Huế in March 1885 was a textbook urban storm. The squadron first closed the seaward approaches and shelled the citadel and the gates; the sappers then blew a breach at dawn, and the storming columns entered the fighting in the streets with the Gatling guns and revolving cannon. The defenders driven back into the citadel found the inner gate barred and the passages narrow, and fire and cold steel appeared together between the stone walls. In the same month the action at Zhennan Pass was the only proper Chinese counter-offensive of the war: Feng Zicai drew up the sabre companies and the dense infantry in front of the pass, waited for the French attack to be checked and their order to come apart, and charged back at the White Rampart, retaking Wenyuan and Zhennan. Thereafter, with the Yunnan army in Tonkin and French reinforcements arriving, the Chinese settled into a defensive posture, wearing the French down at prepared positions, and neither side had the strength left for another large set-piece battle.
data: 可核對的數字大致如下。法軍在北越的兵力，一八八四年春天約一萬五千人上下（含外籍兵團、安南與東京籍的印度支那步槍兵、法國本土營及雇傭部隊），到一八八五年增援抵達後增至三萬人以上。中國方面，西線廣西軍約兩萬人上下，一八八五年春入越的滇軍約一萬五千人，黑旗軍則是數千人規模的流動部隊；北黎與紙橋兩役中，法方記載的中方攻擊兵力都是數千人。加特林機槍本身的規格是：每分鐘射速數十發至一百餘發，口徑在十毫米級，整槍連三腳架重數十公斤，須由數人抬運，因此常配彈藥手車隨行。最可靠的傷亡數字來自北黎：一八八四年三月二十三日法軍縱隊出動約八百人，配二挺加特林及若干轉管砲，結果法軍陣亡一百餘人、受傷四百餘人、失聯十餘人，攻方的死傷法方記載為數以計千。紙橋之役法軍出動約五百人與二挺加特林，自身傷亡數十人。鎮南關之役法軍方面死傷各說不同，清方記載有斬獲法軍軍官與軍馬，但雙方都沒有留下可信的總數；順化之役法軍突擊兵力約二千至三千人，守軍數千人。戰爭本身的時間點是：一八八四年三月一日法軍攻下北寧城樓，三月二十三日北黎之役，八月二十三日馬尾海戰並砲擊福州船政局，同年十一月李鴻章與寶建在北京簽訂中法條約；一八八四年冬法軍在清軍反攻下退守興化；一八八五年三月十八日順化陷落，三月二十三日鎮南關交戰，四月法軍放棄諒山撤往南方，六月九日在北京簽訂中法越南條約。
dataEn: The figures that can be checked run roughly as follows. The French force in Tonkin numbered about fifteen thousand men in the spring of 1884, counting the Foreign Legions, the Indochinese tirailleurs of Annam and Tonkin, the French metropolitan units and the hired companies, and it rose to more than thirty thousand once the reinforcements of 1885 had arrived. On the Chinese side the Guangxi Army on the western front numbered around twenty thousand, the Yunnan army that entered Tonkin in the spring of 1885 numbered about fifteen thousand, and the Black Flag Army was a mobile force of a few thousand men; in both the action at Bac Le and the Paper Bridge the French records put the attacking strength on the Chinese side in the thousands. The specifications of the Gatling gun itself were: a rate of fire from several dozen rounds a minute to upwards of a hundred, a calibre in the ten-millimetre class, a weight of several dozen kilograms for the gun and tripod together, which meant it had to be carried by several men and usually travelled with an ammunition cart in attendance. The most reliable casualty figures come from Bac Le: on 23 March 1884 the French column went out with about eight hundred men, two Gatling guns and a number of revolving cannon, and came back with more than a hundred dead, more than four hundred wounded and a dozen or so missing, while the French accounts put the losses of the attackers in the thousands. At the Paper Bridge the French fielded about five hundred men and two Gatling guns and lost several dozen of their own. At Zhennan Pass the French losses are given differently by different accounts; the Chinese records speak of French officers and horses taken, but neither side left a figure that can be trusted, and in the assault on Huế the French committed two to three thousand men against a garrison of several thousand. The dates of the war itself run: 1 March 1884, the citadel of Bac Ninh falls to the French; 23 March, the action at Bac Le; 23 August, the naval action at Mawei and the shelling of the Fuzhou shipyard; November 1884, Li Hongzhang and Paul Beau sign the Sino-French convention at Peking; in the winter of 1884 the French are driven back to Huong Hoa by the Chinese counter-offensive; 18 March 1885, Huế falls; 23 March, the fighting at Zhennan Pass; April, the French give up Lang Son and withdraw southwards; and 9 June, the Sino-French convention on Vietnam is signed at Peking.
cause: 打起來有四層原因。最外一層是法國的遠東政策：法國要在印度支那建立一個統一的殖民政體，把安南併入安南－東京總督區，再打通雲南的商路，把紅河水系連同雲南的礦產與市場一併納入法方軌道。一八八三年清廷與法方就雲南通商、裁撤黑旗軍等條款達成妥協，法軍卻步步越界，先後攻佔河內與北寧，同年五月的紙橋之役後，衝突由零星交火升為成建制的對戰。第二層是清廷的藩屬觀：越南是中國的藩屬，法國兼并安南在道義與體面上都被視為對中國邊疆的直接侵犯，因此清廷明知實力不及也不可能正式承認；一八八四年清廷一面議和、一面備戰，這種拖延的做法反而把戰爭拖成持久消耗。第三層是雲南邊境的糾紛：法方教士與商人在雲南擴張勢力，與當地官府、百姓的衝突不斷，雲南各府對法方並無好感，地方官員也不願替法國催辦打交道，邊民甚至仇視洋教士，這使雲南一線的協助始終不順。第四層是法國國內政治：茹費理政府需要一場對外勝利來轉移注意力、維持議會多數，軍方與殖民部則主張直接打到雲南，把邊界推到與廣西接壤的地帶；一旦開火，巴黎便不打算停下來。
causeEn: There were four layers of cause. The outermost was French policy in the Far East: France wanted a single colonial administration in Indochina, with Annam folded into the Governor-Generalship of Annam and Tonkin, and then the road into Yunnan opened, so that the Red River system together with the minerals and the markets of Yunnan would be drawn into the French orbit. In 1883 the Qing court and the French reached an accord on such matters as trade in Yunnan and the disbandment of the Black Flag Army, but the French army went on overrunning the terms, taking Hanoi and Bac Ninh in turn, and after the Paper Bridge in May of that year the clashes between the two sides rose from scattered engagements to battles between formed bodies of troops. The second layer was the Qing view of the vassal relationship. Vietnam was a Chinese vassal, and the French annexation of Annam was seen, both on principle and on grounds of face, as a direct affront to the Chinese frontier, so the court could not formally consent even while it knew it was no match. During 1884 the Qing negotiated on one front and prepared on the other, and this dragging of the feet turned the war into a grinding contest of endurance instead. The third layer lay in the border districts of Yunnan, where French missionaries and merchants were pushing their position and collided repeatedly with the local authorities and the people; the prefectures of Yunnan had no affection for the French, local officials would not press the French on their own business, and the border population often hated the foreign clergy, which made assistance from the Yunnan front consistently difficult. The fourth layer was domestic politics in France: the Ferry government needed a foreign victory to distract attention and hold its majority in parliament, while the army and the colonial department wanted to drive straight into Yunnan and push the frontier back until it met Guangxi; and once the firing started, Paris had no intention of stopping.
impact: 這場戰爭的直接後果是清廷承認法國對越南的保護權，越南從此實質上成為法屬印度支那的一部分，阮朝在法國保護下以「安南國」之名存續到一九五四年。清廷在西南方向的藩屬格局就此崩解，越南北部、中越邊界與雲南的行政與軍事安排全部重畫，廣西與雲南從此直接面對法國的邊境；法國則在紅河三角洲得到一個可以長期經營的殖民政府，並以此為基地向老撾與柬埔寨方向延伸，一八九〇年代法軍已深入老撾，一九〇七年柬埔寨被正式置於法國控制之下。國內政治的影響同樣深：馮子材的鎮南關大捷被描繪成晚清少有的對外勝利，關外軍、白泮洲與將士用命成為清末民族敘事裡反覆被引用的意象；反對方則把中法條約的讓步歸咎於李鴻章的退讓，張之洞因主戰而受稱道，岑春煊因擅自議和被黜，這場戰爭把主戰與主和兩派在清廷內部徹底分開。對日本與整個東亞的刺激更為長遠：法國在遠東得手說明歐洲列強確實能用現代化軍隊改寫亞洲秩序，日本朝野既受激勵也受威懾，幾年後的甲午戰爭在東方與西方都常被視為中法戰爭的延伸，而臺灣與澎湖的割讓正是這條路徑的終點。軍事技術上，加特林與轉管砲這類速射武器在實戰中的價值被各國看得更清楚，法軍自己在越南的經驗直接推動了速射砲的普及；黑旗軍作為一支沒有國家正式編制的部隊，其存廢問題也牽動了清廷此後對邊境的管理方式。
impactEn: The direct consequence of the war was that the Qing court recognised French protection over Vietnam. Vietnam became in substance part of French Indochina, and the Nguyễn dynasty survived under French protection as the Kingdom of Annam until 1954. The vassal structure of the Qing on its southwestern side collapsed; the administration and the military arrangements of northern Vietnam, of the Sino-Vietnamese border and of Yunnan were all redrawn, and Guangxi and Yunnan now faced the French frontier directly. France, for its part, obtained in the Red River delta a colonial administration it could work for the long term, and used it as a base for expansion towards Laos and Cambodia: French troops were deep into Laos by the 1890s, and Cambodia was formally placed under French control in 1907. The effect on domestic politics was equally deep. The victory of Feng Zicai at Zhennan Pass was described as one of the rare foreign successes of the late Qing, and the Army of the Outer Pass, the White Rampart and the image of officers and men giving their lives became images quoted again and again in late Qing national narratives. On the other side, the concessions in the Sino-French convention were blamed on Li Hongzhang's retreat, Zhang Zhidong was praised for insisting on war, and Cen Chunxuan was disgraced for negotiating on his own; the war split the Qing court cleanly into a party for war and a party for peace. The stimulus to Japan and to eastern Asia as a whole was of longer reach. The fact that France had won in the Far East showed that the European powers really could rewrite the order of Asia with modernised armies, and the Japanese public was both encouraged and frightened by the lesson. The Sino-Japanese War of a few years later was read in both East and West as an extension of the Sino-French War, and the cession of Taiwan and the Pescadores was the end of that road. On the technical side, the value of rapid-fire weapons such as the Gatling gun and the revolving cannon was seen more clearly than ever by every army, and the French experience in Vietnam directly pushed the spread of quick-firing guns. The Black Flag Army, a body of troops with no regular national establishment, raised the same question for the Qing court about how the frontier was to be administered afterwards.
result: 結果是法軍的有限勝利與清廷的全面退讓。經過一八八五年三月的拉鋸，法軍攻下順化、取得對紅河三角洲與海防一帶的控制，卻始終沒能突破鎮南關與諒山，馮子材在關前的反攻與滇軍在側翼的進攻，使法軍無法把戰線推進到廣西腹地；四月初法軍放棄諒山與北寧，向南撤退，戰事至此結束。四月裡法軍自越南北部撤出，六月九日李鴻章與法國代表在北京簽訂中法越南條約，清廷承認法國對越南的保護權，並確認雲南的蒙自等地設埠通商，法國取得在紅河流域的駐防權。戰爭還帶來兩項附帶結果：一是黑旗軍被清廷下令裁撤，劉永福率部退回廣西，這支在戰爭中出力最多、也最令法軍頭痛的部隊就此解散；另一是法國在遠東的地位獲得確認，此後它在越南與中國南部邊境的擴張再沒有另一個歐洲國家挑戰。回頭看，這場戰爭是清朝藩屬體系崩解的起點，也是甲午戰爭的預演：清廷既失去了越南，也失去了對朝鮮的實際控制，而日本人正是從越南的例子裡讀出了侵略鄰國可以成功的公式。
resultEn: The result was a limited French victory and a comprehensive Chinese retreat. After the see-saw of March 1885 the French took Huế and gained control of the Red River delta and of the coast around Haiphong, but they never broke through at Zhennan Pass or at Lang Son: the counter-attack by Feng Zicai in front of the pass and the pressure of the Yunnan army on the flank kept the French from carrying the war into the heart of Guangxi. In the first days of April the French gave up Lang Son and Bac Ninh and withdrew southwards, and with that the fighting was over. During April the French forces withdrew from northern Tonkin, and on 9 June Li Hongzhang and the French representative signed the Sino-French convention on Vietnam at Peking. The Qing court recognised French protection over Vietnam and confirmed the opening of places such as Mengzi in Yunnan to foreign trade, and France obtained the right to garrison the Red River valley. Two further results came with the war. The Black Flag Army was ordered disbanded by the Qing government and Liu Yongfu led it back to Guangxi, and the body of troops that had done more than any other in the war, and that had worried the French most, disappeared. And France's standing in the Far East was confirmed, so that its expansion in Vietnam and along the southern Chinese border was thereafter challenged by no other European power. Looked at from the end, the war was the beginning of the collapse of the Qing vassal system and the rehearsal for the Sino-Japanese War: the court had lost Vietnam, and it had lost effective control over Korea as well, and the Japanese had read in the Vietnamese example the formula by which a neighbouring state could be invaded with success.
